enrollment.effect: Enable daily fiscal observation for all living countries. Preserve existing cash and debt; unopened treasuries receive no cash and recognize debt from their current debt ratio. Unopened treasuries receive no cash and recognize existing debt. This changes campaign rules and future economic behavior; it grants no factories, equipment or debt relief.

mission.objective: Keep operating factories and equipment lines supplied.
mission.title: Protect the next 90 days

primary_action.detail: Operating factories and equipment lines create supply requirements here. Set construction funding in Economy.
primary_action.label: Return to command

offers.because: A command economy that has stopped delivering, or prices out of control
offers.blurb: Free prices, end the subsidies, take the recession. Inflation breaks; output and legitimacy break with it.
offers.name: Shock Therapy

offers.because: Inflation above 15% with a central bank nobody believes
offers.blurb: Tie the currency to a hard one and import its credibility. Inflation falls fast. You give up the rate as a tool.
offers.name: Peg the Currency

offers.because: Still poor enough for the world to want what you can make
offers.blurb: Point the whole economy outward: undervalue, subsidise the exporters, suppress consumption. Growth, bought from your own households.
offers.name: Export-Led Industrialisation

offers.because: A debt trajectory that requires recovery (legacy campaigns: debt above 90%)
offers.blurb: Raise taxes by up to five points and trim discretionary spending. Essential services and maintenance are protected in recovery campaigns. The vote costs 9 stability; debt only improves when the budget delivers.
offers.name: Fiscal Consolidation

offers.because: A state that owns its industry and cannot afford to run it
offers.blurb: Sell or give away the state's industry. Productivity rises eventually. The people who lose their jobs notice first.
offers.name: Mass Privatisation

offers.because: A restive population and a government willing to coerce it
offers.blurb: Put the apparatus on the street. Order returns. Everyone who cares about how you govern stops pretending they do not notice.
offers.name: Security Crackdown

offers.because: An authoritarian state under pressure it cannot simply crush
offers.blurb: Open it up. The world warms to you and your own people find their voice — including the ones who never wanted to be ruled by you.
offers.name: Political Liberalisation

warfare_adoption.effect: Enable theatre operations, deployment journeys, supply reports and negotiated peace. Existing equipment, supplier stock and paid contracts retain their property. This changes future campaign rules; save a separate slot first if you want to retain the former rules.

forecast.reason: Forces must complete deployment before fighting.

last_report.summary: Forces are in reserve or moving to their assigned sector.

mission_constraints: Support missions are constrained by delivered supply.

aim_options.description: Hold named opposing districts and negotiate cession.
aim_options.label: Recover territory

aim_options.description: Seek political opening; local institutions determine leadership.
aim_options.label: Political transition
